==Creation==
To make ultracompost, players must use two [[volcanic ash]] on a bucket of [[supercompost]]. To make it in a compost bin, players must add 25 volcanic ash to a [[compost bin]] (50 on a [[Big Compost Bin]]) containing supercompost, and then collect it using [[bucket]]s. 25 (or 50) volcanic ash is consumed regardless of the "fullness level" of the compost bin, so it is recommended to add it before removing any supercompost. Each bucket of ultracompost collected grants the player 10 Farming experience.

After the player has read the [[ash covered tome]], they can use the [[Lunar spells|Lunar spell]] [[Fertile Soil]] on a patch with two [[volcanic ash]] in their inventory to give the same effect as ultracompost.
